propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same exact identity in both retired and live states, which must be detected and repaired safely without violating read-only operations.

Incomplete-operation recovery must be extracted behind the facade and invoked at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary after the under-lock staleness gate but before any remote issue fetch, to prevent interleaving new liveness evidence with completion.
Recovery must require exact agreement of local id and Jira key across tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry; mismatches or corrupt entries must safety-abort without mutation.
Explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion; later automatic confirmations (200/clear_absent/same-key bind_confirm) do not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.
The rich-text handler mutation through all_bindings() must be replaced with the narrow S2 facade operation to eliminate production code mutating bindings through broad accessors.
